# axm_webhook (Resource)

Manages an Apple Business Manager webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "axm_webhook" "device_changes" {
  name              = "Device change notifications"
  enabled           = true
  event_types       = ["ORG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGED"]
  secret_wo         = var.webhook_secret
  secret_wo_version = 1
  url               = "https://example.com/webhooks/apple"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `event_types` (Set of String) The event types to subscribe to: ORG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGED, ORG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_MIGRATION_DETAILS_CHANGED, ORG_DEVICE_RELATIONSHIP_ASSIGNED_SERVER_CHANGED, or ORG_DEVICE_RELATIONSHIP_WARRANTY_CHANGED.
- `name` (String) The name of the webhook.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The shared secret used by Apple to sign webhook notifications. This value is write-only and is never stored in Terraform state.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Increment this value to trigger an update when rotating secret_wo.
- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL that receives webhook notifications.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_date_time` (String) The date and time the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) The webhook ID.
- `updated_date_time` (String) The date and time the webhook was last updated.
